# Joel's decisions

Joel Belton's own words, requests and rulings for MergeToMaster, newest first. This is the
**J** source in the Brand, Motion and Edit Systems and in `rules.md`.

Rules for this file:

- Quote Joel verbatim. Put our reading of a quote under it, labelled as ours.
- Give every entry a scope: **channel** (every video), **video** (one video), or
  **instance** (one shot). Silence on a shot is not a ruling.
- A preference is not a ban. His preferences are strong defaults; break one only when the
  video's purpose needs it, and log the reason in that video's brief.
- When Joel confirms, corrects or strikes a rule, add an entry here first, then update
  `rules.md` and the system page.

|---|---|---|---|
| Add visuals I judge appropriate, rather than his timestamped notes | Video (P2) | He trusts the P1 approach; placement is ours to decide | Visual plan first (M-16) |

| Fewer visuals than P1 | Video (P2) | Density request; pacing still met with footage and punch-ins | E-05, M-16 |
| No time pressure | Video (P2) | Scheduling only | None |
| Next week: longer, more story-driven | Next video | A second run with a different structure | None yet |

## 2026-09-14 · P1 · three change requests after delivery

Fixed and delivered on 14 September 2026
(`P1 - Frontend Design/Animations using Hyperframes/MergeToMaster/client-fixes/2026-09-14/DELIVERY.md`).

| Shot | Change Joel asked for | Scope | Joel's reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fd_S04_50ms_v08` | Remove the one-frame Prim & Paw website flash (frame 2) | Instance | Not yet asked |
| `fd_S04_button-states_v08` | Remove the bottom Feedback demonstration caption and its divider | Instance | Not yet asked |
| `fd_S04_character_v08` | Remove the bottom demonstration caption and its divider | Instance | Not yet asked |

Joel's exact wording is not in this folder; copy it here from Frame.io or the message
thread. All three shots were additions he had not asked for. These are change requests,
not removals of whole animations, and they are three instances, not channel rules yet.

Candidate rules they suggest (ours, unconfirmed): nothing on screen for only a frame or
two (M-26), and no caption that describes a demonstration the viewer can already see
(B-29). Ask Joel why before treating either as his standard.

## Before P1 · Joel's video brief (Notion)

Quoted in Edit System v1, sections 04, 05, 06 and 08. The original Notion page is not in
this folder; link it here when available.

| Joel's words | Scope | Applied as |
|---|---|---|
| AI imagery or AI video: "It's too obvious." | Channel | J-01: strong default, not a ban |
| Heavy stock B-roll: a little is fine; anything that reads as stock is not | Channel | J-02 |
| "add music where appropriate but nothing too distracting" | Channel | J-03, E-09 |
| Rough cut first, with no B-roll, music or animation until he has reviewed it | Channel | J-04 |
| Sound: mouse clicks, keyboards and "anything else appropriate" | Channel | J-05, M-25 |
| "please do add your own creativity and flair to the videos, I'm open to suggestions." | Channel | J-06 |
| "change it every 10–20 seconds" after the opening; "cut frequently in the first 30 seconds, use B-roll" | Channel | J-07, E-05 |
| Praised Dreams of Code for its pacing | Channel | E-05 (measured 7.6 s body cadence) |
| Palette and graphics: his threads-and-processes Short, and the Table.mp4 and filing.mp4 references he put in Frame.io | Channel | B-01, B-17, B-21 (measured) |
